sections.title: 1. Schema & Metadata
sections.intro: Introspect the live graph model: labels, relationship types, property keys, counts and the APOC meta-graph.

entries.desc: Total node count in the graph
entries.cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) AS total_nodes

entries.desc: Total relationship count in the graph
entries.cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN count(r) AS total_relationships

entries.desc: All node labels with per-label counts (descending)
entries.cypher: MATCH (n) UNWIND labels(n) AS label RETURN label, count(*) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

entries.desc: All relationship types with per-type counts (top 12)
entries.cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS rel_type, count(*) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 12

entries.desc: Distinct property keys present in the database
entries.cypher: CALL db.propertyKeys() YIELD propertyKey RETURN collect(propertyKey) AS property_keys

entries.desc: Whole-database meta statistics via APOC
entries.cypher: CALL apoc.meta.stats() YIELD labelCount, relTypeCount, nodeCount, relCount RETURN labelCount, relTypeCount, nodeCount, relCount

entries.desc: Database components / versions (kernel, edition)
entries.cypher: CALL dbms.components() YIELD name, versions, edition RETURN name, versions, edition

entries.desc: Installed APOC and GDS plugin versions
entries.cypher: RETURN apoc.version() AS apoc_version, gds.version() AS gds_version

sections.title: 2. Retrieval & Filtering
sections.intro: Core read patterns: lookup by name, label scans, WHERE predicates, string matching, DISTINCT, ORDER / SKIP / LIMIT.

entries.desc: Find a gene/protein node by exact name
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein {node_name: $name}) RETURN n.node_name, n.node_id, n.node_source

entries.desc: List 5 drug nodes (label scan with LIMIT)
entries.cypher: MATCH (d:drug) RETURN d.node_name AS drug, d.node_index AS idx LIMIT 5

entries.desc: Case-insensitive prefix search on disease names (STARTS WITH)
entries.cypher: MATCH (d:disease) WHERE toLower(d.node_name) STARTS WITH 'anemia' RETURN d.node_name AS disease LIMIT 6

rows: anemia, congenital hypoplastic, with multiple congenital anomalies/in…
anemia, nonspherocytic hemolytic, possibly due to defect in porphyrin…
anemia, nonspherocytic hemolytic, associated with abnormality of red …
anemia, nonspherocytic hemolytic, due to G6PD deficiency

entries.desc: Substring search on drug names (CONTAINS)
entries.cypher: MATCH (d:drug) WHERE d.node_name CONTAINS 'cillin' RETURN d.node_name AS drug LIMIT 6

entries.desc: Regular-expression match on gene names (=~)
entries.cypher: MATCH (g:gene_protein) WHERE g.node_name =~ '^TP5[0-9].*' RETURN g.node_name AS gene LIMIT 6

entries.desc: Distinct node sources used across the graph
entries.cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN DISTINCT n.node_source AS source ORDER BY source

entries.desc: Pagination: diseases ordered by name, skip 10 take 5
entries.cypher: MATCH (d:disease) RETURN d.node_name AS disease ORDER BY disease SKIP 10 LIMIT 5

sections.title: 3. Aggregation & Grouping
sections.intro: count / avg / collect / percentile aggregations and grouped rollups.

entries.desc: Average protein-protein degree across all proteins
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein)-[:protein_protein]-() WITH n, count(*) AS deg RETURN avg(deg) AS avg_degree, max(deg) AS max_degree, min(deg) AS min_degree

entries.desc: Top 8 most-connected proteins by PPI degree (grouped count)
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein)-[:protein_protein]-() RETURN n.node_name AS protein, count(*) AS degree ORDER BY degree DESC LIMIT 8

entries.desc: Collect the first 10 drug names into a single list
entries.cypher: MATCH (d:drug) WITH d LIMIT 10 RETURN collect(d.node_name) AS drug_sample

entries.desc: Degree distribution percentiles for proteins (50/90/99th)
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein)-[:protein_protein]-() WITH n, count(*) AS deg RETURN percentileCont(deg,0.5) AS p50, percentileCont(deg,0.9) AS p90, percentileCont(deg,0.99) AS p99

entries.desc: Relationship-type histogram for one hub protein
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein {node_name:$name})-[r]-() RETURN type(r) AS rel_type, count(*) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

sections.title: 4. Pattern Matching & Traversal
sections.intro: One-hop neighbours, multi-hop expansion, variable-length paths, OPTIONAL MATCH and pattern comprehension.

entries.desc: Direct protein interactors of a hub protein (one hop)
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein {node_name:$name})-[:protein_protein]-(m) RETURN m.node_name AS interactor LIMIT 6

entries.desc: Proteins associated with a disease (typed one-hop)
entries.cypher: MATCH (dis:disease)-[:disease_protein]-(p:gene_protein) WHERE dis.node_name CONTAINS 'anemia' RETURN dis.node_name AS disease, p.node_name AS protein LIMIT 6

entries.desc: Two-hop protein neighbourhood size (distinct)
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein {node_name:$name})-[:protein_protein*2]-(m) RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS two_hop_reach

entries.desc: Variable-length path 1..3 hops between two named proteins (existence)
entries.cypher: MATCH (a:gene_protein {node_name:$src}) MATCH p = (a)-[:protein_protein*1..3]-(b:gene_protein {node_name:$dst}) RETURN length(p) AS hops LIMIT 1

entries.desc: OPTIONAL MATCH: drug with its (possibly absent) indicated diseases
entries.cypher: MATCH (d:drug {node_name:$drug}) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:indication]-(x:disease) RETURN d.node_name AS drug, collect(x.node_name)[0..5] AS indications

entries.desc: Pattern comprehension: a protein's interactor names inline
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein {node_name:$name}) RETURN [(n)-[:protein_protein]-(m) | m.node_name][0..6] AS interactors

sections.title: 5. Path Finding
sections.intro: Native shortestPath / allShortestPaths plus GDS weighted Dijkstra.

entries.desc: Shortest PPI path between two proteins (native shortestPath, ≤5 hops)
entries.cypher: MATCH (a:gene_protein {node_name:$src}), (b:gene_protein {node_name:$dst}), p = shortestPath((a)-[:protein_protein*..5]-(b)) RETURN [x IN nodes(p) | x.node_name] AS path, length(p) AS hops

entries.desc: Count of all shortest PPI paths between two proteins
entries.cypher: MATCH (a:gene_protein {node_name:$src}), (b:gene_protein {node_name:$dst}), p = allShortestPaths((a)-[:protein_protein*..5]-(b)) RETURN count(p) AS num_shortest_paths, min(length(p)) AS hops

entries.desc: Cross-domain reasoning path: drug → protein → disease (≤4 hops)
entries.cypher: MATCH (d:drug {node_name:$drug}), (dis:disease) WHERE dis.node_name CONTAINS 'anemia' MATCH p = shortestPath((d)-[*..4]-(dis)) RETURN [x IN nodes(p) | coalesce(x.node_name,'?')] AS path, length(p) AS hops LIMIT 1

rows: [Copper, ALB, Sulfamethoxazole, folic acid deficiency anemia]

sections.title: 6. GDS Graph Projection & Centrality
sections.intro: Project the protein-protein interaction (PPI) sub-network into the GDS in-memory catalog, then run the full suite of centrality algorithms. Centrality ranks the most structurally important proteins.

entries.desc: Project the PPI network (gene_protein nodes + protein_protein edges, UNDIRECTED)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.graph.project('ppi', 'gene_protein', {protein_protein: {orientation: 'UNDIRECTED'}}) YIELD graphName, nodeCount, relationshipCount RETURN graphName, nodeCount, relationshipCount

entries.desc: Degree centrality — most-connected proteins (top 5)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.degree.stream('ppi') YIELD nodeId, score RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).node_name AS protein, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: PageRank — influence by recursive importance (top 5)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.pageRank.stream('ppi', {maxIterations:20, dampingFactor:0.85}) YIELD nodeId, score RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).node_name AS protein, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: ArticleRank — PageRank variant reducing low-degree bias (top 5)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.articleRank.stream('ppi', {maxIterations:20}) YIELD nodeId, score RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).node_name AS protein, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: Eigenvector centrality — influence weighted by neighbours' influence (top 5)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.eigenvector.stream('ppi', {maxIterations:20}) YIELD nodeId, score RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).node_name AS protein, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: Betweenness centrality — bridge proteins (sampled, top 5)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.betweenness.stream('ppi', {samplingSize:1000, samplingSeed:42}) YIELD nodeId, score RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).node_name AS protein, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: Closeness centrality — proteins central by short distance to all others (top 5)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.closeness.stream('ppi') YIELD nodeId, score RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).node_name AS protein, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

sections.title: 7. GDS Community Detection
sections.intro: Partition the PPI network into communities / modules and measure local clustering. Communities surface functional protein modules.

entries.desc: Louvain modularity communities — size of the 5 largest
entries.cypher: CALL gds.louvain.stream('ppi') YIELD nodeId, communityId RETURN communityId, count(*) AS members ORDER BY members DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: Weakly Connected Components — size of the 5 largest components
entries.cypher: CALL gds.wcc.stream('ppi') YIELD nodeId, componentId RETURN componentId, count(*) AS members ORDER BY members DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: Label Propagation communities — 5 largest
entries.cypher: CALL gds.labelPropagation.stream('ppi', {maxIterations:10}) YIELD nodeId, communityId RETURN communityId, count(*) AS members ORDER BY members DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: Modularity Optimization — number of communities and largest size
entries.cypher: CALL gds.modularityOptimization.stream('ppi', {maxIterations:10}) YIELD nodeId, communityId RETURN count(DISTINCT communityId) AS communities, count(*) AS nodes_assigned

entries.desc: K-1 Coloring — number of colors needed (graph coloring)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.k1coloring.stream('ppi') YIELD nodeId, color RETURN count(DISTINCT color) AS distinct_colors, count(*) AS nodes

entries.desc: Triangle Count — proteins forming the most triangles (top 5)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.triangleCount.stream('ppi') YIELD nodeId, triangleCount RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).node_name AS protein, triangleCount ORDER BY triangleCount DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: Local Clustering Coefficient — graph-wide average cohesion
entries.cypher: CALL gds.localClusteringCoefficient.stream('ppi') YIELD nodeId, localClusteringCoefficient RETURN avg(localClusteringCoefficient) AS avg_clustering_coefficient

sections.title: 8. GDS Similarity & Node Embeddings
sections.intro: Jaccard node similarity over shared interactors, FastRP structural embeddings, and KNN over those embeddings. Embeddings are then persisted to power the vector index in §9.

entries.desc: Node Similarity (Jaccard over shared interactors) — top 5 protein pairs
entries.cypher: CALL gds.nodeSimilarity.stream('ppi', {topK:1, similarityCutoff:0.5}) YIELD node1, node2, similarity RETURN gds.util.asNode(node1).node_name AS protein_a, gds.util.asNode(node2).node_name AS protein_b, similarity ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: FastRP — generate 64-dim structural embeddings (sample vector)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.fastRP.stream('ppi', {embeddingDimension:64, randomSeed:42}) YIELD nodeId, embedding RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).node_name AS protein, embedding LIMIT 3

entries.desc: FastRP mutate — write 64-dim embeddings into the in-memory projection
entries.cypher: CALL gds.fastRP.mutate('ppi', {embeddingDimension:64, mutateProperty:'embedding', randomSeed:42}) YIELD nodePropertiesWritten, computeMillis RETURN nodePropertiesWritten, computeMillis

entries.desc: KNN over FastRP embeddings (cosine) — 5 nearest-neighbour protein pairs
entries.cypher: CALL gds.knn.stream('ppi', {nodeProperties:['embedding'], topK:1, randomSeed:42, concurrency:1, sampleRate:0.5}) YIELD node1, node2, similarity RETURN gds.util.asNode(node1).node_name AS protein_a, gds.util.asNode(node2).node_name AS protein_b, similarity ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT 5

entries.desc: Persist FastRP embeddings from projection back to Neo4j nodes
entries.cypher: CALL gds.graph.nodeProperties.write('ppi', ['embedding']) YIELD propertiesWritten RETURN propertiesWritten

entries.desc: List in-memory GDS graphs (catalog inventory)
entries.cypher: CALL gds.graph.list() YIELD graphName, nodeCount, relationshipCount, memoryUsage RETURN graphName, nodeCount, relationshipCount, memoryUsage

sections.title: 9. Indexes, Constraints, Full-text & Vector Search
sections.intro: Schema objects that make production queries fast: range/text indexes, uniqueness constraints, a full-text index over entity names, and a cosine VECTOR index over the FastRP embeddings written in §8.

entries.desc: Create a RANGE index on gene_protein.node_name
entries.cypher: CREATE RANGE INDEX gene_name_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:gene_protein) ON (n.node_name)

entries.desc: Create a TEXT index on disease.node_name (substring search acceleration)
entries.cypher: CREATE TEXT INDEX disease_name_text IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:disease) ON (n.node_name)

entries.desc: Create a uniqueness CONSTRAINT on drug.node_index
entries.cypher: CREATE CONSTRAINT drug_idx_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (d:drug) REQUIRE d.node_index IS UNIQUE

entries.desc: List all indexes currently defined
entries.cypher: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name, type, entityType, labelsOrTypes, properties RETURN name, type, labelsOrTypes, properties ORDER BY name

entries.desc: List all constraints currently defined
entries.cypher: SHOW CONSTRAINTS YIELD name, type, labelsOrTypes, properties RETURN name, type, labelsOrTypes, properties

entries.desc: Create a FULLTEXT index over names of drugs, diseases and genes
entries.cypher: CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX entity_names IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:drug|disease|gene_protein) ON EACH [n.node_name]

entries.desc: Full-text search for 'anemia' across all entity names (ranked)
entries.cypher: CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes('entity_names', 'anemia') YIELD node, score RETURN labels(node)[0] AS label, node.node_name AS name, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 6

entries.desc: Create a cosine VECTOR index over the 64-dim FastRP embeddings
entries.cypher: CREATE VECTOR INDEX protein_embedding_vec IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:gene_protein) ON (n.embedding) OPTIONS {indexConfig: {`vector.dimensions`: 64, `vector.similarity_function`: 'cosine'}}

entries.desc: Vector KNN search — proteins most similar to a query protein's embedding
entries.cypher: MATCH (q:gene_protein {node_name:$name}) WHERE q.embedding IS NOT NULL CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('protein_embedding_vec', 6, q.embedding) YIELD node, score RETURN node.node_name AS similar_protein, score ORDER BY score DESC

sections.title: 10. APOC Procedures & Functions
sections.intro: APOC helpers for meta-modelling, weighted degree, path expansion, collection maths and text utilities.

entries.desc: APOC node degree (total) for a hub protein
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein {node_name:$name}) RETURN apoc.node.degree(n) AS total_degree

entries.desc: APOC meta-graph: which node labels connect via which relationships (sample)
entries.cypher: CALL apoc.meta.graphSample() YIELD nodes, relationships RETURN size(nodes) AS label_count, size(relationships) AS rel_pattern_count

entries.desc: APOC path expansion: unique proteins within 2 PPI hops of a hub
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein {node_name:$name}) CALL apoc.path.subgraphNodes(n, {relationshipFilter:'protein_protein', maxLevel:2}) YIELD node RETURN count(node) AS nodes_within_2_hops

entries.desc: APOC collection stats over a degree sample
entries.cypher: MATCH (n:gene_protein)-[:protein_protein]-() WITH n, count(*) AS d LIMIT 500 WITH collect(d) AS degs RETURN apoc.coll.max(degs) AS max, apoc.coll.min(degs) AS min, apoc.coll.avg(degs) AS avg

entries.desc: APOC text utilities: clean & capitalize a drug name
entries.cypher: RETURN apoc.text.capitalizeAll(toLower($drug)) AS pretty_name

sections.title: 11. Production Analytical Scenarios
sections.intro: End-to-end questions a biomedical analyst or the Eugene chat agent would actually ask — drug repurposing, hub discovery, shared-target reasoning and disease comorbidity structure.

entries.desc: Drug-repurposing: drugs targeting proteins linked to a disease
entries.cypher: MATCH (dis:disease)-[:disease_protein]-(p:gene_protein)-[:drug_protein]-(d:drug) WHERE dis.node_name CONTAINS 'anemia' RETURN d.node_name AS candidate_drug, count(DISTINCT p) AS shared_targets ORDER BY shared_targets DESC LIMIT 6

entries.desc: Most disease-associated proteins (potential master regulators)
entries.cypher: MATCH (p:gene_protein)-[:disease_protein]-(d:disease) RETURN p.node_name AS protein, count(DISTINCT d) AS disease_count ORDER BY disease_count DESC LIMIT 6

entries.desc: Shared targets between two drugs (mechanistic overlap)
entries.cypher: MATCH (d1:drug)-[:drug_protein]-(p:gene_protein)-[:drug_protein]-(d2:drug) WHERE d1.node_name < d2.node_name RETURN d1.node_name AS drug_a, d2.node_name AS drug_b, count(DISTINCT p) AS shared ORDER BY shared DESC LIMIT 6

entries.desc: Disease comorbidity by shared phenotypes (anemia cohort, top pairs)
entries.cypher: MATCH (a:disease) WHERE a.node_name CONTAINS 'anemia' MATCH (a)-[:disease_phenotype_positive]-(ph:effect_phenotype)-[:disease_phenotype_positive]-(b:disease) WHERE a.node_name < b.node_name WITH a, b, count(DISTINCT ph) AS shared_phenotypes RETURN a.node_name AS disease_a, b.node_name AS disease_b, shared_phenotypes ORDER BY shared_phenotypes DESC LIMIT 6

entries.desc: Pathway enrichment: pathways with the most member proteins
entries.cypher: MATCH (pw:pathway)-[:pathway_protein]-(p:gene_protein) RETURN pw.node_name AS pathway, count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC LIMIT 6
